# Creating a compute machine set on {{ aws_short }} {#creating-machineset-aws}

You can create a different compute machine set to serve a specific purpose in your OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ aws_first }}. For example, you might create infrastructure machine sets and related machines so that you can move supporting workloads to the new machines.
